description: The stage most people quit in. With to sew, the gap between wanting to and being able to is measured in months, and the months are the content.
energy_note: Months, and they are the thing.

description: Autotelic activity - done for its own sake rather than for a reward - is the category Csikszentmihalyi built the whole model from. Chosen learning behaves completely differently from assigned learning.
energy_note: Chosen, which changes the whole character of it.

aspect: Somebody to be bad in front of
description: The single biggest predictor of continuing is one other person who is also learning it, or who already knows and is not contemptuous about it.
energy_note: One person who will not laugh.

description: Uninterrupted hours, which is the scarcest input in this entire dataset - and electricity, connectivity or a tool, depending. Shift work, caring duties and power cuts kill more self-directed learning than lack of aptitude.
energy_note: Hours in a row, which almost nobody has.
notes: Pairs with PWR and WRK in assets/text/nigeria.

description: Learning to sew stops being an event and becomes a reference point - retold, compared against, and eventually shorthand inside one family for a whole kind of day.
energy_note: It turns into the story about it.
notes: Experiential purchases retain value through memory where material ones decay; people are markedly unwilling to trade the memory away.
